description:
The contractor shall accomplish the work specification package as outlined in the provided drawings and specification, and as attached in Section J ATTACHMENT (I).
The contractor will be responsible for ship repair work to include providing the necessary management, scheduling, testing, quality assurance, technical documentations to support the YRB-30 FY26 WOO Availability.


NOTE: The requirements in DFARS 252.211-7003, Item Identification and Valuation, are applicable for this line item. The contractor shall provide DoD unique identification, or a DoD recognized unique identification equivalent.
